description: Zogres take a quarter of the damage ordinary weapons roll: accuracy is untouched but the hitsplat is reduced by 75%. Crumble Undead is halved instead, and brutal arrows are exempt entirely from either ogre bow, the plain bow limited to mithril brutal arrows and the composite bow able to fire every type. First match wins, so the Crumble Undead half precedes the brutal-arrow exemption and the fourfold reduction everything else takes.

quotes: Zogres are almost immune to normal weapons (you will hit just as often, but damage is reduced by 75%).
Brutal arrows are effective against them, as is the Crumble Undead spell (however, damage is halved, for a maximum of 7).
Ogre bows can only fire up to mithril brutal arrows, while composite ogre bows can fire all types

description: A hatched araxyte is always max hit by the noxious halberd, by a crush weapon when crush is the loadout's highest-accuracy style, and by a crossbow or ballista when Ranged is; anything else rolls damage normally. The weapon test is crossbow-or-ballista rather than the heavy ranged class, which also holds chinchompas, and the halberd clause is style-free. Not modelled: the eggs, the minions' own attacks, and Mirrorback's aura.

quotes: Players will always max hit when attacking the hatched araxytes with a noxious halberd, crush weapons, or heavy Ranged weapon (such as a crossbow or ballista) if crush or ranged is their highest accuracy style respectively.
Attacking the hatched eggs with anything else - or attacking the unhatched eggs - does not guarantee a max hit, and rolls damage normally.

description: Monsters a combat style cannot miss or under-hit: the attack simply lands for max, with no formula behind it. The ids and the styles they apply to live in always-max-hit-targets.json, each stated on its own article, and the row is keyed by id because the bestiary's quest NPC of the same name is not Yama's judge. Not modelled: Volatile Baboon and Baboon Thrall, which no source covers, and Yama's void flares, whose guarantee is restricted to a weapon class and so has its own row.

quotes: Players are guaranteed to land a max hit on Ba-Ba's baboons.
players will deal their max hit on them regardless of gear.
With a 100% elemental weakness to water spells and a guaranteed max hit
This article is about the judge in the Yama fight.

description: Demonbane attacks always land against the Abyssal Sire's spawns whatever the player's bonuses, though the hit is still rolled for damage rather than guaranteed to be a max. Battery-exempt: the row covers the spawns only, with any weapon.

quotes: Demonbane attacks will always land as successful hits against them regardless of the player's bonuses, but will not guarantee a max hit.

description: Yama's void flares are always max hit by Magic and by standard-class Ranged weapons, meaning bows and arrows rather than blowpipe or crossbow; melee gets no guarantee. The ranged half is a weapon class rather than a whole style, which is why this is not a row in always-max-hit-targets.json. Not modelled: the Contract of Bloodied Blows, which removes the guarantee entirely.

quotes: Additionally, players are guaranteed a maximum hit when attacking them with magic or Standard Ranged weapons.
In the Contract of Bloodied Blows, more void flares spawn when they appear and players are no longer guaranteed a max hit against them.

description: While the Hueycoatl's braziers are lit every player deals 30% more damage, applied here as a 13/10 multiplier on the hitsplat the damage cap has already resolved, so the ceiling is 13/10 of what the cap allows through rather than of the raw roll. The buff is the player's rather than a property of the part, and covers head and tail only: the body is fought in phase one, before the seer begins charging the pillars. A team of one or two cannot meet the protection-prayer requirement to charge all three pillars and so never earns the buff.

quotes: While the braziers are lit, players are given a 30% damage buff
Teams with only one or two players can not meet the balanced active protection prayer requirement to charge all three pillars and therefore cannot earn the damage buff.

options.label: Braziers lit
options.help:
Lighting the braziers gives every player a 30% damage bonus for as long as they burn.
Needs three or more players: "Teams with only one or two players can not meet the balanced active protection prayer requirement to charge all three pillars and therefore cannot earn the damage buff."
On by default — turn it off for a solo or duo. The body is fought before the pillars can be charged, so it never carries the buff.

description: A Chambers of Xeric Guardian takes damage only from a pickaxe, and each hitsplat is scaled by 50 plus the player's Mining level plus the pickaxe tier's Mining requirement, over 150, applied to the damage already rolled. The requirement is the tier's rather than the item's wield level, and is capped so the crystal pickaxe matches the dragon one; no source states a minimum, so a scaled hitsplat can truncate to zero below a combined Mining level and tier requirement of 100. Not modelled: the tunnel spawn timing, the melee-only reach, and party scaling.

quotes: These statues must be destroyed in order to pass the room and can only be harmed with pickaxes; all other sources of damage will not count.
The damage modifier is ((50 + Mining level + pickaxes's level req) / 150). That's applied to whatever damage you rolled; Void would have been factored in before this calculation occurs.
The formula is capped to ensure the Crystal pickaxe deals the same damage as the Dragon pickaxe, despite having a higher mining level requirement.
The damage modifier is ((50 + Mining level + pickaxes's level req) / 150). That's applied to whatever damage you rolled; Void would have been factored in before this calculation occurs.

description: Tekton is immune to Ranged and takes 80% reduced Magic damage, so each magic hitsplat divides by 5, with a floor of 1.

quotes: Tekton is immune to Range and takes 80% reduced Magic damage.

description: Glowing crystals are immune to Ranged damage and take a third of magic damage. The third has no floor, so a small divided hit can reach zero.

quotes: They are weak to stab attacks, immune to ranged damage (including the ranged thrall), and take 1/3rd damage from magic attacks.

description: Ranged damage to the Kraken is divided by seven with a floor of 1, a rolled zero stays zero, and accuracy is unaffected. Melee is handled by the separate KrakenImmunity row.

quotes: Magic is the only reliable way of damaging it, as Ranged deals 1/7th of its normal damage.
If you rolled 0 damage, it stays as 0. If you rolled >=1 damage, it's divided by 7, with a floor of 1. Accuracy is not affected.
If you rolled 0 damage, it stays as 0. If you rolled >=1 damage, it's divided by 7, with a floor of 1. Accuracy is not affected.

description: A broodoo victim caps the player's max hit at 3 rather than scaling damage, a replacement ceiling that leaves attack speed as the only thing separating loadouts. Not modelled: the consumables that actually kill them, being food, poison cures and disease cures.

quotes: They are highly resistant to conventional attack methods (the player's max hit is reduced to 3)

description: The Corporeal Beast halves every rolled hitsplat except magic, and except a corpbane weapon used on the stab attack style; a ranged corpbane weapon is exempt on the flag alone, since the stab qualifier can only cover the melee corpbane weapons. The halving lands after the accurate-hits-deal-1 raise and before flat armour. Not modelled: the dark energy core's heal, and the 100 damage cap on the spear path this never halves.

quotes: The Corporeal Beast has a 50% damage reduction against any weapon that is not a Corpbane weapon on stab attack style.
Although magic attacks also deal full damage, they are generally very inaccurate against the boss.
deals full damage to the Corporeal Beast

description: The ice demon reduces all damage to a third, except from fire spells and demonbane weapons. Only the reduction lives here: the fire multiplier is the demon's elemental weakness and the demonbane bonus its demonbane vulnerability, both already carried in the monster data. A fire cast means a spell actually being cast, so a powered staff is reduced like anything else, and demonbane is read as the wiki's demonbane weapon definition, letting demonbane spells and the scorching bow escape alongside the melee demonbane weapons.

quotes: all damage dealt to the demon is reduced by 67%, except for fire spells (which deal 250% damage) and demonbane weapons
Increased to 150% for a fire spell, decreased to 33% otherwise.

description: A slagilith reduces damage to a third unless a pickaxe is equipped, spells and arrows included, with no scaling for the attacker's level. The third is taken post-roll with a minimum of zero, so a small hitsplat really can be reduced to nothing. Not modelled: the ranged projectile-swap timing exploit, the five-minute despawn, and the wiki's manual-cast magic setup that keeps a pickaxe equipped, which the search cannot build because a pickaxe is not a magic weapon.

quotes: will reduce your damage by 67% if a pickaxe is not equipped
as long as a pickaxe is equipped

The Slagilith is a much simpler one than the CoX guardians. It just reduces the damage to 33% if the attacker isn't wielding a pickaxe. There's no scaling for level. Earth elementals don't seem to have any special pickaxe code at all, other than waking them up.

description: Each Great Olm part takes full damage from one combat style and 66% mitigation from the other two: the head from Ranged, the left claw from Melee, the right claw from Magic. The implemented reading of that 66% is one third of the rolled hitsplat, truncated, applied post-roll with no minimum. Accepted delta: the oracle omits melee mitigation on the head and right claw. Not modelled: the head's self-heal, hand-disable phase gating, and Chambers of Xeric party scaling.

quotes: The head has 66% damage mitigation from all non-range attacks, and will heal itself if hit outside of Olm's final phase. Olm's right hand (also called mage hand) has 66% damage mitigation from all non-mage attacks. Olm's left hand (also called melee hand) has 66% damage mitigation from non-melee attacks.

description: Damage dealt to the Abyssal Sire while it transitions between phases is halved, per hitsplat and post-roll, so a rolled 1 halves to 0 and the expectation is not simply half the ordinary one. Off by default, since a transition is a passage the fight goes through rather than a state to plan a loadout around.

quotes: Damage dealt to the Sire while it is transitioning between phases is reduced by 50%.

options.label: Between phases
options.help:
While the Sire is moving between phases, all damage to it is halved.
Off by default: a transition is a passage the fight goes through, not a state to plan a loadout around.

description: All damage dealt to Delrith is doubled while Silverlight is equipped. Delrith carries no demon attribute, so Silverlight's usual demonbane bonus never applies and without this rule it is simply a bad sword, which is why the item is pinned into the search. Not modelled: the doubled ring of recoil hits, and the quest requirement to have Silverlight equipped at the killing blow.

quotes: All damage dealt to Delrith is doubled when Silverlight is equipped

description: Each Awakened Altar still active reduces damage to Skotizo by 15% with Arclight or Emberlight to a maximum of 60%, and by 25% with any other weapon to a maximum of 100%, so four altars and an ordinary weapon deal nothing at all. The row states the surviving percent instead, so the capped reduction is one division. Not modelled: whether the game scales each hitsplat or the roll, so the multiply lands on the expectation, which is not the same shape; and the reduction is narrowed to weapon damage, leaving thrall damage untouched, so the four-altar ordinary-weapon case is zero weapon damage rather than zero DPS.

quotes: These altars reduce all damage inflicted on Skotizo while they are active. If Arclight or Emberlight is equipped, each altar reduces damage by 15% up to a maximum of 60%. Otherwise, with other weapons, it's 25% each up to a maximum of 100%.

options.label: Active altars
options.help:
Each Awakened Altar still up reduces your damage to Skotizo — 15% each (max 60%) with Arclight or Emberlight, 25% each (max 100%) with any other weapon.
With all four up and a non-demonbane weapon you deal no damage at all, which is why the altars decide the weapon here rather than the DPS numbers. Defaults to 0 — the state you fight him in once they are cleared.

description: Doubles the damage a magic attack deals to the Nightmare's totems. The doubling lands on the expected hit rather than on each hitsplat, which makes no rounding difference for a plain factor of two.

quotes: The totems take 2x damage when attacked with magic.

description: Quarters damage dealt to the Alchemical Hydra while a phase's 75% damage reduction is still up, that is until it is lured over the matching chemical vent. The reduction is uniform across styles, so it never changes gear ranking. Not modelled: whether the game scales each hitsplat or the roll, so the multiply lands on the expectation instead, which is not the same shape; and thrall damage, which the wiki's incoming damage covers but which is added after this row.

options.label: Chemical vent sprayed
options.help:
For the first three phases the Hydra takes 75% less damage until it is lured onto the matching chemical vent.
Leave this on for the number you actually plan around — the ranking of your gear is identical either way, since the reduction hits every weapon and style equally.

quotes: At the start of each phase, it has a 75% damage reduction, which can be removed if it is lured over a vent on the floor which spews chemical liquid.

description: Multiplies ranged accuracy by six against the Royal Titans while they are out of melee distance, the hidden bonus that offsets their high ranged defence.

quotes: despite their high ranged defences of +700, players get a hidden +500% (a 6x multiplier) to ranged accuracy whenever the titans are out of melee distance.

options.label: Out of melee range
options.help:
The Royal Titans grant a hidden 6x ranged accuracy bonus while they are out of melee distance — the counterweight to their +700 ranged defence.
Leave this on unless you are deliberately standing next to them with a ranged weapon, in which case ranged accuracy is as bad as the stat block suggests.

description: Builds the magic defence roll of the flagged monsters from their Defence level instead of their Magic level, the documented exception to the usual magic defence roll. The substituted level is read after the drain stage, so a Defence drain moves this roll; the undrainable-defence family is what stops that for Verzik.

Makes a demonbane weapon destroy an Abyssal Sire respiratory system outright, rolling its damage window at the target's full hitpoints. The accuracy roll still happens, since the guarantee covers the damage of a hit that lands rather than that it lands. Ordered ahead of the plain respiratory-system row so the demonbane branch matches first.

quotes: Demonbane weapons (other than holy water) will always destroy the respiratory systems in one hit regardless of the player's stats.
Upon a successful hit, demonbane weapons and spells (other than holy water) will destroy them instantly regardless of the player's bonuses.

description: Replaces the normal zero-to-max roll against an Abyssal Sire respiratory system with a uniform roll from half the max hit, rounded down, up to the max hit. Applied as a hitsplat shaper rather than a distribution of its own, so a multi-hitsplat weapon keeps the rule with each splat rolling over half its own ceiling. Not modelled: the fight's phases and vent stun timing, and how the floor divides across a scythe's three splats, which the wiki does not state.

quotes: Players will always hit at least 50% of their weapon's maximum hit on the respiratory systems

description: Against Salarin the twisted a standard strike spell always deals 9, 10, 11 or 12 damage, set by the highest tier of spell the player's visible Magic level unlocks and unaffected by magic damage gear. Modelled as a certain hit at that tier taken through the accuracy chance, which is the splash chance, with the tier read as the highest bolt spell max hit. Not modelled: ring of recoil and dynamite(p).

quotes: the spells will always deal 9, 10, 11, or 12 damage, depending on the highest tier of spell unlocked, as long as the player does not splash
This damage is not affected by items that would normally increase spell damage
minimum of 80 ticks

description: A matching standard-spellbook elemental cast gains accuracy and damage equal to the monster's elemental weakness percentage of the base roll and base spell max hit, floored on its own and added as a flat share rather than multiplied through the stages above it. The addend lands after the slayer and salve stage.

quotes: For every percentage point of elemental weakness that an NPC has, the player will gain an extra 1% magic damage and 1% magic accuracy to their attacks. The bonus to magic damage is added after all previous magic damage sources, such as equipment or bonuses from the Slayer helmet (i) or Salve amulet (i).
Max Hit = ⌊ ⌊ Base Max x ( 1 + Magic Damage % ) ⌋ x ( 1 + Slayer or Salve % ) ⌋ + ⌊ Base Max x Elemental Weakness % ⌋
Elemental weakness is calculated by multiplying the base max damage by the monster's weakness, and rounding down. This additional damage is then added to the maximum hit determined above.

description: A tormented demon's fire shield takes 20% off damage from weapons and spells that are neither demonbane nor abyssal, applied post-roll per hitsplat and floored at 1, in the two shielded phases. Out of scope: how shield phases track fire bombs, and the demons' own attacks.

quotes: Tormented demons usually have a fire shield that reduces damage done by non-demonbane weapons/spells and non-abyssal weapons by 20%.
All weapons that are not classified as abyssal or demonbane deal 20% reduced damage against tormented demons.

options.label: Demon phase
options.help:
A Tormented Demon's fire shield takes 20% off everything but demonbane and abyssal weapons.
It drops after each fire bomb, and about 30 ticks in the demon is defenceless (every attack lands).
While unshielded, slow crush, heavy Ranged and spellcasting gain a large flat bonus.

description: In both non-default demon phases every attack lands whatever the rolls say, the defenceless window that gives the player 100% accuracy.

quotes: Roughly 30 ticks (18s) after the start of the fight, the demon will become defenceless, giving the player 100% accuracy when attacking it

description: While a tormented demon's shield is down, spells, heavy ranged weapons and crush melee gain a flat damage bonus of the weapon's attack speed squared minus 16, added before the zero-to-one raise so a rolled zero lands as the bonus rather than as 1. The bonus grows with the square of the speed, so the slowest crush weapon in the bank can beat the fastest, a ranking no raw stat carries. Out of scope: the divide-by-three, rounded down, when the weapon matches the demon's protection prayer, which needs a monster prayer no input carries.

quotes: all damage dealt by specific weapons is increased by X 2 - 16 , where X is the weapon's attack speed.
Melee weapons set to the crush attack style
Heavy ranged weapons (crossbows and ballistae)
Spells (not from a powered staff).
the attack speed and damage bonus will still apply, but be divided by 3 and rounded down

description: While the shield is down the qualifying attack's speed is set to 4 ticks rather than decremented: the article's shield-down table reads 4 ticks against one demon for standard speeds 7, 6, 5 and 4-or-faster alike. Out of scope: the table's multi-demon columns, which need a demon count no input carries, and the divide-by-three when the weapon matches the demon's protection prayer.

quotes: The attack speed for this one attack is also set to 4 ticks (2.4s)
4 or faster
the attack speed decreases by one tick per additional demon

description: Melee never reaches the Leviathan, so melee setups are excluded against it outright.

quotes: Your melee attacks can't reach the lure!

description: Standing in the abyssal pathfinder's area of effect grants perfect accuracy to ranged attacks on the Leviathan. The guarantee is Ranged's alone; magic is paid in damage instead.

quotes: will be granted perfect accuracy and an increased minimum hit
Attacking with magic instead of ranged while within the pathfinder's AoE will grant doubled damage instead of perfect accuracy.

options.label: Fight situation
options.help:
The Leviathan pays differently by moment.
In the pool: ranged cannot miss and hits for at least 20% of its max; magic gets double damage instead.
Stunned: damage is capped at 10 — unless you are at the backside, where ranged hits for at least 65% of its max and magic deals double damage.

description: In the abyssal pathfinder's area of effect magic deals doubled damage on an otherwise ordinary roll with its ordinary accuracy, so the doubled hit really can land for twice the usual ceiling.

quotes: Attacking with magic instead of ranged while within the pathfinder's AoE will grant doubled damage instead of perfect accuracy.

description: Attacking the stunned Leviathan's gaping wound with magic keeps the usual accuracy roll but doubles the damage, the pathfinder pool's two-sided shape again, with Ranged paid in a raised floor and magic in damage.

quotes: attacking with magic is not guaranteed to hit and is subject to the usual accuracy rolls, but will deal double damage

description: In the abyssal pathfinder's area of effect a ranged hit on the Leviathan lands for at least 20% of the max hit. Applied as a hitsplat shaper, so the raised minimum layers onto every splat the bow fires rather than replacing the distribution.

quotes: it's ensuring you hit for at least 20% of your max

description: Ranged attacks on the stunned Leviathan's backside land for at least roughly 65% of the max hit; being stunned anywhere else is the 10 damage cap held in damage-caps.json. Applied as a hitsplat shaper, so the raised minimum layers onto every splat the bow fires.

quotes: When attacking the backside with ranged, it deals at least a minimum of ~65% of your maximum hit as damage

description: The Wardens P2 accuracy window floor: inside the core-exposed window the hit always lands, with damage scaled by what the player's accuracy would have been.

quotes: the player having 100% accuracy regardless of equipment; however, the damage dealt corresponds to the player's accuracy

description: The Wardens P2 window's ceiling, (modifier + 20)% of the max hit; see WardensP2MinWindow for the window itself. Non-monotone roll arithmetic, which is why a wardens search runs with bound pruning off.

Scales magic damage by how many targets a multi-target ancient spell clumps hit, up to nine in a 3x3 grid around the primary target. The engine models one monster, so every target carries the same hit chance, but secondaries are not a clean multiply by the target count: a salve amulet's bonus does not carry to the secondary targets of a multi-hitting magic attack while an imbued black mask's does, so secondaries are weighted by a second Magic max hit with the neck additive dropped and the mask restored, over the primary's. The Brimstone ring is the one bonus the primary does not share, and its own row dilutes itself across the clump. Ordered last with the other target-count entries, since everything above scales damage to one enemy and this multiplies by how many there are. Not modelled: Smoke's poison chance, Blood's leech, Ice's freeze, or whether the player is in a multi-way area at all.

quotes: up to nine targets in a 3x3 grid around its primary target
any secondary targets hit will also be subject to the damage bonus from a worn black mask (i)/slayer helmet (i)
but not for multi-hitting magic and ranged attacks (ex. chinchompas and burst spells)
